Transfer amount feeds directly into tax and balance arithmetic.

New buy tax parameter is validated and written by updateTax.
Ratio parameter is used solely to recompute the limit struct.
Lock duration is consumed only when extending the unlock time.

Wallet address parameter is written into the tax wallet struct.
Permille fraction bounds how much pair balance is swapped.
Sell flag only branches the tax selection inside the taxed path.
Selected tax rate is a transient local used in amount math.
Computed tax amount is a transient local split between sinks.
ETH amount parameter is split into the marketing/dev/staking shares.
Verification string is hashed and compared against the hardcoded hash before the value call.
